group.title: A supplier quality update
group.passage: Our incoming inspection team found scratches on some of the aluminum covers delivered this week. The affected batch has been placed on hold and will not enter production. We have asked the supplier to examine the protective packaging and send a corrective action report by Tuesday. The earlier batch passed inspection and can still be used. Purchasing will coordinate replacement covers once the supplier confirms the delivery schedule. Please report any similar damage through the quality portal.
group.passageZh: 進料檢驗團隊在本週交付的部分鋁製上蓋上發現刮痕。受影響批次已暫停使用，不會投入生產。我們已要求供應商檢查保護包裝，並最遲在星期二提供矯正措施報告。較早的批次檢驗合格，仍可使用。供應商確認交期後，採購會協調替換上蓋。若發現類似損傷，請透過品質入口網站回報。
